cues: Two angles and a side: the sine law.
Two sides and an opposite angle: also the sine law, but watch for two possible triangles, which is the next unit.
Two sides and the included angle: cosine or tangent law.
Three sides: cosine or half angle laws.
text: Which law for which data? Two angles and a side: the sine law. Two sides and an opposite angle: also the sine law, but watch for two possible triangles, which is the next unit. Two sides and the included angle: cosine or tangent law. Three sides: cosine or half angle laws.
